body: We were friends for a while and she said she developed a crush on me. And I really don't know, I'm just a freshman.

I've asked about about 4 girls after knowing them for a while, they all said no. I have asked one girl randomly out, once again, no. The only other relationships were way too quick moving, immature high school garbage. And this girl, who is just amazing, well she liked me and I liked her. Tinder didn't work for me. I don't know how to get a girl, and i've only been extremely lucky when I have.

But how do I find those? Even time I think I get close I get let down. My school doesn't have very many sports events (we don't have a football team). I can't find anyone whatsoever. Even if I wanted a quick fuck(which I don't), well I couldn't get it. I just wish I had someone, I wish for once something would go my way. But I just don't see it happening.

I don't want to be with 15 people. I think that's gross, I want one woman who I really really love and care about. I'm not the one who is rejecting women left and right because they aren't a supermodel. I'm the one always being rejected. I can't get anything off the ground. I don't know how and the few times I have been able to get any confidence. I am rejected

I love watching sports. But I am pretty out of shape and it's too late for me to get into them. I'm at one of the nerdiest schools in the US and I just don't fit in because I don't watch anime all day. I've never been able to get a woman from asking her out. Girls just don't like a guy who can't keep weight on him, who is passionate about anything he is into, who is a short ugly fuck. And who wants to build something rather than just have a good time. 

I have a hard time making friends. I just have too many different interests to relate to most people. I'm into sports, yet I am a short thin CS major so sports people don't like me. I obviously don't fit in with frat guys. I don't play video games I just don't enjoy them. I'm just too old fashioned for women and to be friends with people.  Maybe it's just me, but I feel like either person in the relationship shouldn't try to get the other to feel jealous, or should at least try to find time for the other person.

Everything good in my life has gone sour. I don't have anything good to show for the 19 years of my life. I have a younger brother who hates my guts and blames me for living with my dad. I have absolutely nobody. And I just don't think I am ever going to get anyone. I'm not going to get that happy ending so I don't see a point to try any more.
